headings: Placing Customer Places a Sales Order - Through EBay
text: eBay Marketer imports eBay orders (auctions and store orders) to get paid orders by specifying begin/end time, views orders placed in that time, and then selects orders to import. eBay Marketer reviews imported orders and manually approves them, mainly making sure orders match the orders in eBay. If Placing Customer orders multiple items they will come in as separate orders and eBay Marketer will combine the orders into a single order.
limitation: No verified browser workflow in the installed Marble components; storefront, integration, manual action or mapping required.
